strings.ui.c3.protocol.title: Seating plan and interpreters’ log
strings.ui.c3.protocol.subtitle: Opening session · Item 4 “Annex C”
strings.ui.c3.protocol.instruction: Lay the name cards down in the order in which people spoke on Annex C. The log gives only time and microphone – the seating plan reveals who sat at which microphone.
strings.ui.c3.protocol.wrong: The order doesn’t match the log. Compare times and microphones again.
strings.ui.c3.protocol.incomplete: Lay down all four cards first.
strings.ui.c3.protocol.hint: The microphones are numbered clockwise, starting at the chair. Count off the seats around the horseshoe – the secretariat has a table of its own.
strings.ui.c3.protocol.success: Paragraph four came from the secretariat as a finished text – not from a delegation. The Reich delegation already knew the wording; the Soviet one fell in line. Nobody asked.
strings.ui.c3.protocol.controls: 1–4 place card · Backspace take back last card · R rearrange · Enter check · Esc close
strings.ui.c3.protocol.error: The comparison can’t be checked right now. {error}
strings.ui.c3.protocol.state_full: All cards are down – check the order.
strings.ui.c3.protocol.slot_filled: Speaker {n}: {name} – select to take the card back
strings.ui.c3.protocol.card_tip: {name} – place in the next free speaker slot
strings.ui.c3.protocol.plan.title: Seating plan
strings.ui.c3.protocol.plan.subtitle: Great Hall · Opening session
strings.ui.c3.protocol.log.r2.remark: “No objections to the version of 12 January.”
strings.ui.c3.protocol.log.note: RU: escorted persons – DE: escorted goods!
strings.doc.c3.seating.alt: Seating plan in the Great Hall: a horseshoe table, the chair at the top with microphone 1. On the right arm the Soviet delegation – its uppermost microphone is number 2. At the lower ends of the arms the observers (Sweden on the right, Switzerland on the left), on the left arm the Reich delegation. The secretariat sits at a table of its own on the open side: microphone 12. Legend: microphones clockwise from the chair (1).
strings.doc.c3.booth_log.alt: Log sheet, booth 2 (RU ⇄ DE), agenda item 4 “Annex C”, typed: 10:02 microphone 1 (FR) – opening. 10:06 microphone 9 (DE) – “No objections to the version of 12 January.” 10:09 microphone 12 (FR) – reads out § 4, prepared text; beside it Elena’s marginal note: “RU: escorted persons – DE: escorted goods!” 10:11 microphone 3 (RU) – “We concur.”
